parts.visual:
A startup spends two years building a video game. No one plays it. But the team realizes the internal chat tool they built for the game is actually incredible. They abandon the video game completely and launch the chat tool as a B2B product. They call it 'Slack'.

The Hard Reset:
1. The Pivot: A fundamental change in the core business model, target market, or product strategy, while retaining the same team and corporate entity.
2. The Ego Check: A pivot requires the founder to look at their original 'genius' idea, admit to the entire company that it was wrong, and throw away years of hard work.
parts.audio: A pivot is not a minor adjustment; it is an existential reboot. It is the realization that your current path leads to certain death, and your only hope of survival is to jump off the train and start running in a completely different direction.

questions.question: A founder realizes their original product has zero market demand. They have $1 Million left in the bank. The team begs the founder to just spend more money on marketing. What is the correct action?
options: Spend the $1 Million on Google Ads.
Pivot immediately. Marketing cannot fix a product that nobody wants. The founder must use the remaining $1 Million to build a completely different product before the company dies.
questions.correct_answer: Pivot immediately. Marketing cannot fix a product that nobody wants. The founder must use the remaining $1 Million to build a completely different product before the company dies.
questions.explanation: You cannot market your way out of zero Product-Market Fit.

questions.question: Listen to the CEO explaining the pivot to the investors. Why is the CEO confident in the new direction?
questions.tts_text: We are abandoning the consumer app. It failed. But during the failure, 50 enterprise companies contacted us asking to buy the backend API we built to run the app. We are pivoting to sell the infrastructure.
options: Organic Evidence. A good pivot is not a random guess made in a panic. A good pivot is driven by hard data discovered accidentally while building the first failed product.
questions.correct_answer: Organic Evidence. A good pivot is not a random guess made in a panic. A good pivot is driven by hard data discovered accidentally while building the first failed product.
questions.explanation: The best pivots are discovered, not invented.

questions.question: What is the psychological danger of a 'Fake Pivot'?
options: It looks bad on a resume.

A fake pivot is just changing the logo or adding one small feature while keeping the core broken business model. It creates the illusion of action without solving the existential crisis, guaranteeing the company will slowly bleed to death.
questions.correct_answer: A fake pivot is just changing the logo or adding one small feature while keeping the core broken business model. It creates the illusion of action without solving the existential crisis, guaranteeing the company will slowly bleed to death.
questions.explanation: A pivot must be painful enough to actually change your trajectory.

questions.question: Why do many early employees quit when a startup announces a massive pivot?
options: Because they joined to build the original vision. If an engineer joined to build a consumer gaming app, and the company pivots to building accounting software for banks, that engineer is now working at a company they never signed up for.
questions.correct_answer: Because they joined to build the original vision. If an engineer joined to build a consumer gaming app, and the company pivots to building accounting software for banks, that engineer is now working at a company they never signed up for.
questions.explanation: A pivot is essentially starting a brand new company. Not everyone will want to stay.

pairs.match: A fundamental shift in business strategy to avoid failure
Making superficial changes while ignoring the core broken business model
Refusing to pivot because you have already invested years of hard work
Unexpected market demand discovered while building a different product
